info.name: Ticket system
Ticketsystem
info.summary: Kundesupport med sager, direkte i Nextcloud
info.description:
Ticket system turns customer requests into tickets your team handles inside Nextcloud.
- Tickets with status, priority, tags and assignment - @mentions and snooze - Reports: volume, response and resolution times - Time registration per ticket, customer companies and hourly rates, with an overview and CSV export for invoicing - Replies scheduled for later - Email intake: the support inbox turns into tickets, replies thread onto the right ticket - Public replies to the customer and internal notes that never leave the team - A private web page per ticket where customers follow and answer their request - Notifications, Activity stream, Dashboard widget, unified search and ticket cards where a ticket link is pasted - Events for every ticket change, so add-in apps can extend it without touching the core
info.author: Co-Optimize
